title: Public acceptability, bioethics, and legal governance of wastewater and environmental surveillance for measles in South Africa
abstract: Abstract Objectives This study investigates public opinion regarding the use of wastewater and environmental surveillance for measles in South African urban centres across ethical, legal, and public health policy themes, and maps these opinions onto existing bioethical and legal precedents. Design In-person field survey. Setting Three metropolitan catchment areas in Gauteng Province, South Africa (City of Tshwane, City of Ekurhuleni, and City of Johannesburg). Participants A sample of 100 adult community members residing or working within the selected sewer catchment areas. Primary outcome measures Baseline wastewater and environmental surveillance awareness, target-specific acceptability, spatial monitoring preferences, data-sharing comfort, and legal/privacy perceptions. Results Baseline awareness of WES was low (19%). Support was high for monitoring a range of biological and chemical targets using wastewater and environmental surveillance. However, acceptability was dependent on spatial scale: 83% supported macro-level "city-wide" monitoring, whereas support fell to 28% for localized sampling (individual homes and schools). Institutional trust in data handling was high among scientific and public health bodies. Conclusions Public acceptability of WES for communicable diseases, particularly measles, in urban South Africa is high but conditional upon macro-level data aggregation ("anonymity by aggregation") and governance by dedicated scientific entities. Given strong community support for measles surveillance and its alignment with the country’s bioethical and legal frameworks, the bioethical and legal requirements for this surveillance approach can be satisfied, paving the way for routine implementation of wastewater and environmental surveillance for communicable diseases.

abstract_zh: 摘要 目的 本研究调查了南非城市中心关于废水使用和环境 麻疹 的公众意见,涵盖伦理、法律和公共卫生政策主题,并将这些意见映射到现有的生物伦理和法律先例。设计亲自实地调查。设置 南非豪登省的三个大都市集水区(茨瓦内市、艾库胡莱尼市和约翰内斯堡市)。参与者 在选定的下水道集水区居住或工作的 100 名成年社区成员作为样本。主要结果衡量基线废水和环境 监测 意识、特定目标的可接受性、空间监测偏好、数据共享舒适度以及法律/隐私认知。结果 WES 的基线认知度较低(19%)。使用废水和环境 监测 监测一系列生物和化学目标得到了高度支持。然而,可接受性取决于空间尺度:83%的人支持宏观层面的“全市范围”监测,而支持局部抽样(个人家庭和学校)的人则下降至28%。科学和公共卫生机构对数据处理的机构信任度很高。结论 在南非城市,公众对 WES 对传染病(特别是 麻疹)的接受度很高,但取决于宏观层面的数据聚合(“聚合匿名”)和专门科学实体的治理。鉴于社区对 麻疹 监测 的大力支持及其与国家生物伦理和法律框架的一致性,这种 麻疹 方法的生物伦理和法律要求可以得到满足,为针对传染病的废水和环境 监测 的常规实施铺平道路。

title: Public health unit perspectives on challenges, barriers, and lessons learned from Ontario's 2024-2025 measles outbreak: a mixed-methods survey.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To systematically gather perspectives from public health units (PHUs) on the challenges, barriers, and lessons learned from the multi-jurisdictional measles outbreak in Ontario (October 2024-October 2025). METHODS: We conducted a mixed-methods survey in June/July 2025. We invited PHU staff involved with the measles outbreak and the Ministry of Health to respond to an online engagement survey. We analyzed multi-choice and ranked questions using counts and proportions. For open-ended questions, we conducted an inductive thematic analysis to identify common themes. RESULTS: We included 26 survey responses (83% response rate). At the time of the survey, about two-thirds (68%) of participating PHUs had at least one outbreak-associated case reported since October 2024. Respondents identified the lack of a comprehensive immunization registry (69%), immunization coverage below herd immunity thresholds (39%), workload demands or competing priorities (39%), and excluding susceptible contacts from school or work settings (39%) as their main challenges/barriers. For preparedness and response activities, respondents identified increased human resources capacity (63%) and use of technological tools (38%) for case and contact management as their most impactful strategies, along with enforcement or expansion of provincial school immunization legislation (42%). Lessons learned focused on timely and efficient outbreak response, supporting readiness, modernizing data systems and adopting technological innovations, standardizing and streamlining protocols, community engagement and relationship building, and strategic communications. CONCLUSION: Further public health efforts will be needed to continue to strengthen Ontario's immunization, surveillance, and outbreak preparedness and response actions. These will also contribute to Canada regaining its measles elimination status.

abstract_zh: 目标:系统地收集公共卫生单位 (PHU) 对安大略省多司法管辖区 麻疹 暴发(2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 10 月)的挑战、障碍和经验教训的看法。方法:我们于 2025 年 6 月/7 月进行了一项混合方法调查。我们邀请参与 麻疹 暴发 和卫生部的 PHU 工作人员回答在线参与调查。我们分析了多项选择并使用计数和比例对问题进行了排名。对于开放式问题,我们进行了归纳主题分析,以确定共同主题。结果:我们纳入了 26 份调查回复(回复率为 83%)。截至调查时,大约三分之二 (68%) 的参与 PHU 自 2024 年 10 月以来报告了至少一例 暴发 相关病例。受访者认为,缺乏全面的免疫登记处 (69%)、免疫覆盖率低于群体免疫阈值 (39%)、工作量需求或竞争优先事项 (39%) 以及排除学校或工作环境中的易感接触者 (39%) 是他们的主要挑战/障碍。对于准备和应对活动,受访者认为增加人力资源能力(63%)和使用技术工具(38%)进行病例和接触者管理是最有影响力的策略,同时执行或扩大省级学校免疫立法(42%)。吸取的经验教训集中在及时有效的 暴发 响应、支持准备、现代化数据系统和采用技术创新、标准化和简化协议、社区参与和关系建设以及战略沟通。结论:需要进一步开展公共卫生工作,以继续加强安大略省的免疫接种、监测 和 暴发 的准备和应对行动。这些也将有助于加拿大重新获得 麻疹 消除地位。

title: Communication and capacity in outbreak response: vaccination outreach to ultra-Orthodox communities during Israel's 2025 to 2026 measles outbreak: a mixed-methods study
abstract: Abstract Background Israel's largest measles outbreak since 2018-19 was traced to a single importation in April 2025, with transmission sustained in ultra-Orthodox Jewish communities; by April 2026, 3,624 cases and 17 deaths were recorded. Two explanations compete: community attitudes and messaging, or the physical availability of vaccination; this study examines both. Methods Mixed-methods retrospective study, January 2024 to August 2026, with the months to March 2025 as baseline. Six data streams were combined: epidemiological indicators; a census of Ministry of Health press releases on measles; 169 ultra-Orthodox media items coded by directed content analysis for frame, cited authority and topic, with inter-coder reliability assessed on a 20% sample; a dated series of documented changes in vaccination access; the government procurement register; and counter-vaccination material. Distributions were compared across periods by chi-square and Fisher exact tests. Results Both channels were quiet before the outbreak: 10 ministry releases and 10 community items in 2024. Pro-vaccination advocacy in community media rose from 8.3% of items pre-outbreak to 30.9% during escalation and fell to 17.6% in 2026 (p = 0.10). A rabbinic voice was cited in 14 items, all between May and December 2025 (Fisher p = 0.041), five of them chairs of medical-aid organisations rather than halachic authorities. No item amplified refusal. Access measures, including walk-in and extended-hours vaccination, were followed within two months by first-dose coverage gains among children aged 1 to 6 from 77% to 84% in Jerusalem and 72% to 82.6% in Beit Shemesh. Communication and vaccine access did not always move together: the peak month of official communication brought no documented access expansion, and the public vaccine station list was unchanged from August 2025 to January 2026. A contracted outreach array for the Ultra-Orthodox sector, tendered in 2020, ended in October 2023 and was not renewed; since then, outbreak outreach relied on small, tender-exempt engagements. Conclusions Ultra-Orthodox media were a receptive channel, and rabbinic and community engagement worked once activated. The principal constraint was capacity, not persuasion: standing outreach infrastructure, physical access and maintained public information. Sustaining these between outbreaks, and aligning communication with the access it promotes, are the priorities for measles control.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 摘要背景 以色列自 2018-19 年以来最大的 麻疹 传播 可追溯到 2025 年 4 月的一次输入,传播 在极端正统犹太社区持续存在;截至 2026 年 4 月,已记录 3,624 例病例和 17 例死亡。
elements_zh.methods: 方法 混合方法回顾性研究,2024年1月至2026年8月,以截至2025年3月的月份为基线。
elements_zh.main_results: 结果 在 暴发:2024 年发布 10 个部委版本和 10 个社区项目之前,两个渠道都很安静。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 结论 极端正统媒体是一个接受渠道,拉比和社区参与一旦激活就会发挥作用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 在 麻疹 之间维持这些,并将通信与其促进的访问保持一致,是 麻疹 控制的优先事项。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 主要的限制是能力,而不是说服力:固定的外展基础设施、物理访问和维护的公共信息。

abstract_zh: 摘要背景 以色列自 2018-19 年以来最大的 麻疹 传播 可追溯到 2025 年 4 月的一次输入,传播 在极端正统犹太社区持续存在;截至 2026 年 4 月,已记录 3,624 例病例和 17 例死亡。有两种解释相互竞争:社区态度和消息传递,或者 疫苗接种 的实际可用性;这项研究对两者进行了检验。方法 混合方法回顾性研究,2024年1月至2026年8月,以截至2025年3月的月份为基线。合并了六个数据流:流行病学指标;卫生部关于 麻疹 的人口普查新闻稿;169 个极端正统媒体项目,通过针对框架、引用权威和主题的定向内容分析进行编码,并根据 20% 的样本评估编码器间的可靠性;疫苗接种 访问中一系列已记录的日期更改;政府采购登记册;和反疫苗接种材料。通过卡方检验和费舍尔精确检验比较不同时期的分布。结果 在 暴发 之前,两个渠道都很安静:2024 年有 10 个部委发布和 10 个社区项目。社区媒体中支持 疫苗接种 的宣传从 暴发 之前项目的 8.3% 上升到升级期间的 30.9%,并在 2026 年下降到 17.6%(p = 0.10)。2025 年 5 月至 12 月期间,有 14 个项目引用了拉比的声音(Fisher p = 0.041),其中 5 个项目是医疗援助组织的主席,而不是伊斯兰教权威。没有任何项目放大拒绝。在采取包括上门接种和延长 疫苗接种 服务时间在内的措施后,两个月内,1 至 6 岁儿童的第一剂接种覆盖率从耶路撒冷的 77% 提高到 84%,贝特谢梅什从 72% 提高到 82.6%。通信和 疫苗 访问并不总是一起进行:官方通信的高峰月没有带来有记录的访问扩展,并且公开的 疫苗 电台列表从 2025 年 8 月到 2026 年 1 月没有变化。超正统领域的合同外展阵列于 2020 年招标,于 2023 年 10 月结束,没有续签;从那时起,暴发 的外展活动就依赖于小型的、免招标的活动。结论 极端正统媒体是一个接受渠道,拉比和社区参与一旦激活就会发挥作用。主要的限制是能力,而不是说服力:固定的外展基础设施、物理访问和维护的公共信息。在 麻疹 之间维持这些,并将通信与其促进的访问保持一致,是 麻疹 控制的优先事项。

title: Epidemiology of measles and its surveillance performance in the Oromia regional state of Ethiopia: Progress and challenges toward measles elimination goals
abstract: Abstract Background Despite the effective vaccines and decades of experience towards elimination, measles remains a significant public health problem among children ≤ 15 years, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. A well-functioning surveillance system is essential for monitoring measles transmission and guiding control efforts. Towards this end we analyzed the epidemiology of measles and its surveillance system performance in the Oromia region, Ethiopia. Methods We analyzed the epidemiologic characteristics of the suspected-measles cases with laboratory results reported during 2006–2024 through the case-based surveillance. Frequencies, adjusted odds ratios (aORs), 95% confidence-intervals (CIs), and p-values were calculated using R statistical software. Surveillance performance was assessed using the non-measles febrile rash illness (NMFRI) and district-level surveillance indicators. Results A total of 25,674 suspected-measles cases with laboratory results were reported, of which 9,755 (38.3%) were measles IgM positive. Among confirmed cases, 5,173 (53.0%) were male and 78.2% occurred among children aged

abstract: Measles is a highly contagious acute infectious disease. The six clinical manifestations assessed in this review are fever, cough, coryza, conjunctivitis, shortness of breath, and diarrhea. This literature review aims to analyze differences in these six manifestations in children based on their history or level of measles immunization completion. A search was conducted through PubMed, Google Scholar, and ScienceDirect, prioritizing original studies from 2020–2026. Articles in Indonesian, English, or other languages that were available in full text and could be adequately extracted were included. A total of five pediatric studies were included in the narrative and comparative synthesis. The results showed that fever was the most common symptom across all groups, thus limiting the ability to clinically differentiate immunization status. Cough, coryza, and diarrhea tended to be lower in vaccinated children in some studies, while findings regarding conjunctivitis were inconsistent. Direct evidence regarding shortness of breath is limited because most studies reported indirect respiratory indicators. In conclusion, a history of measles immunization tends to be associated with milder manifestations in some outcomes, but does not exclude the possibility of measles. Diagnosis still requires clinical assessment, epidemiological history, and laboratory confirmation.

abstract_zh: 麻疹是一种传染性极强的急性传染病。本次评价评估的六种临床表现是发烧、咳嗽、鼻炎、结膜炎、气短和腹泻。本文献综述旨在根据儿童的麻疹免疫完成史或水平来分析儿童这六种表现的差异。通过 PubMed、Google Scholar 和 ScienceDirect 进行搜索,优先考虑 2020 年至 2026 年的原创研究。印度尼西亚语、英语或其他语言的文章均包含全文且可充分摘录。叙述和比较综合中总共纳入了五项儿科研究。结果表明,发烧是所有群体中最常见的症状,从而限制了临床区分免疫状态的能力。在一些研究中,接种疫苗的儿童的咳嗽、鼻炎和腹泻往往较少,而有关结膜炎的研究结果却不一致。关于呼吸短促的直接证据有限,因为大多数研究报告了间接呼吸指标。总之,麻疹 免疫史往往与某些结果中较轻的表现相关,但不排除 麻疹 的可能性。诊断仍需要临床评估、流行病学史和实验室确认。

title: Waning Measles Immunity and Sustained Rubella Seroprotection Among Adults in Istanbul, Türkiye
abstract: Background and Objectives: Despite long-standing MMR vaccination programmes, outbreaks of vaccine-preventable diseases continue to occur worldwide, raising concerns regarding waning immunity and susceptibility gaps in adult populations. Between 2017 and 2019 alone, WHO reported over 880,000 measles cases globally—a fourfold increase over the preceding two years—with outbreaks in both low- and high-income countries despite high childhood vaccination coverage. This study evaluated the seroepidemiology of measles, mumps, and rubella among adults in Türkiye over a nine-year period. Materials and Methods: A retrospective laboratory-based study was conducted using ELISA IgM and IgG results obtained between 2014 and 2022 at a tertiary-care university hospital. Seropositivity rates were analysed by year, age group, and sex. Temporal trends were assessed using the Cochran–Armitage trend test; factors associated with IgG seropositivity were assessed using multivariable logistic regression. Results: Among 10,407 adult test records, overall IgG seropositivity was 75.8% for measles, 94.9% for rubella, and 86.3% for mumps; IgM positivity remained low throughout (0.9%, 0.4%, and 1.9%, respectively). Measles IgG declined significantly from 78.4% in 2014–2019 to 62.6% in 2022 (p < 0.001), whereas Rubella IgG remained stable (93.2–95.7%) and Mumps IgG showed no significant temporal change. Seropositivity increased markedly with age for measles (18–29 years: 70.2% vs. ≥50 years: 93.4%; p < 0.001) and mumps (p = 0.030). Multivariable analysis confirmed that Measles IgG seropositivity was substantially lower in 2022 than in the pooled 2014–2019 period (OR = 0.432, 95% CI: 0.319–0.584, p < 0.001). Rubella seroprotection among women of reproductive age was 94.7% (95% CI: 93.9–95.5%), close to but not statistically distinguishable from the 95% population immunity benchmark used in rubella elimination frameworks. Conclusions: A significant measles immunity gap exists among younger adults in Türkiye, with Measles IgG seropositivity declining from 78.4% in 2014–2019 to 62.6% in 2022, consistent with a cohort effect whereby vaccine-era cohorts exhibit lower protection than older adults with naturally acquired immunity. Rubella immunity, by contrast, remained close to the 95% elimination benchmark throughout. These findings underscore the importance of targeted serological surveillance and evidence-based booster vaccination strategies.

This study evaluated the seroepidemiology of measles, mumps, and rubella among adults in Türkiye over a nine-year period. Materials and Methods: A retrospective laboratory-based study was conducted using ELISA IgM and IgG results obtained between 2014 and 2022 at a tertiary-care university hospital. Seropositivity rates were analysed by year, age group, and sex. Temporal trends were assessed using the Cochran–Armitage trend test; factors associated with IgG seropositivity were assessed using multivariable logistic regression. Results: Among 10,407 adult test records, overall IgG seropositivity was 75.8% for measles, 94.9% for rubella, and 86.3% for mumps; IgM positivity remained low throughout (0.9%, 0.4%, and 1.9%, respectively). Measles IgG declined significantly from 78.4% in 2014–2019 to 62.6% in 2022 (p < 0.001), whereas Rubella IgG remained stable (93.2–95.7%) and Mumps IgG showed no significant temporal change. Seropositivity increased markedly with age for measles (18–29 years: 70.2% vs. ≥50 years: 93.4%; p < 0.001) and mumps (p = 0.030). Multivariable analysis confirmed that Measles IgG seropositivity was substantially lower in 2022 than in the pooled 2014–2019 period (OR = 0.432, 95% CI: 0.319–0.584, p < 0.001). Rubella seroprotection among women of reproductive age was 94.7% (95% CI: 93.9–95.5%), close to but not statistically distinguishable from the 95% population immunity benchmark used in rubella elimination frameworks. Conclusions: A significant measles immunity gap exists among younger adults in Türkiye, with Measles IgG seropositivity declining from 78.4% in 2014–2019 to 62.6% in 2022, consistent with a cohort effect whereby vaccine-era cohorts exhibit lower protection than older adults with naturally acquired immunity. Rubella immunity, by contrast, remained close to the 95% elimination benchmark throughout. These findings underscore the importance of targeted serological surveillance and evidence-based booster vaccination strategies.

title: Antiviral Therapy for Measles: Progress, Challenges and Perspectives
abstract: Introduction/Objective Despite the availability of an effective vaccine, measles remains a major cause of pediatric morbidity and mortality worldwide. This review aims to evaluate advances toward the development of specific antiviral treatments for measles by examining current candidates, their molecular targets, available preclinical and clinical data, and key challenges to therapeutic application. Methods An extensive literature search (2000-2026) was conducted using PubMed and official databases (WHO, CDC), including in vitro and in vivo studies (animal models), clinical trials, and international guidelines. The main agents included were ribavirin, favipiravir, remdesivir, ERDRP-0519, GHP-88309, fusion peptide inhibitors, and monoclonal antibodies. Results No antiviral is yet approved specifically for measles; however, several candidates show promise. Ribavirin, a broad-spectrum antiviral, has demonstrated in vitro inhibition of measles virus and clinical benefit in severe cases (especially in immunocompromised patients), although data remain limited. Novel polymerase inhibitors such as ERDRP-0519 and its derivative GHP-88309 have shown effective post-exposure protection in animal models. Nucleoside analogs initially developed for other viruses (favipiravir, remdesivir) exhibit in vitro anti-measles activity. Peptides and monoclonal antibodies targeting the viral fusion protein also demonstrate encouraging results. Discussion Antiviral therapy may improve the management of severe or post-exposure cases, especially in non-vaccinable individuals. Conclusion While vaccination remains the cornerstone of prevention, antiviral therapy may improve the management of severe or post-exposure cases, especially in non-vaccinable individuals. Clinical trials are needed to validate these strategies and consider their integration into future global measles elimination programs.

abstract_zh: 简介/目的 尽管存在有效的 疫苗,但 麻疹 仍然是全球儿科发病率和 死亡率 的主要原因。本综述旨在通过检查当前候选药物、其分子靶点、可用的临床前和临床数据以及治疗应用的关键挑战,评估 麻疹 的特定 抗病毒药物 治疗 的开发进展。方法 使用 PubMed 和官方数据库(WHO、CDC)进行广泛的文献检索(2000-2026 年),包括体外和体内研究(动物模型)、临床试验和国际指南。主要药物包括利巴韦林、法匹拉韦、瑞德西韦、ERDRP-0519、GHP-88309、融合肽抑制剂和单克隆抗体。结果尚未有抗病毒药物专门用于麻疹的批准;然而,一些候选人表现出了希望。利巴韦林是一种广谱 麻疹病毒,已证明对 麻疹病毒 具有体外抑制作用,并且在严重病例(特别是免疫功能低下患者)中具有临床益处,尽管数据仍然有限。ERDRP-0519 及其衍生物 GHP-88309 等新型聚合酶抑制剂已在动物模型中显示出有效的暴露后保护作用。最初为其他病毒开发的核苷类似物(法匹拉韦、瑞德西韦)表现出体外抗 麻疹 活性。针对病毒融合蛋白的肽和单克隆抗体也显示出令人鼓舞的结果。讨论 抗病毒药物 疗法可以改善严重或暴露后病例的管理,特别是对于未接种疫苗的个体。结论 虽然 疫苗接种 仍然是预防的基石,但 抗病毒药物 治疗可以改善严重或暴露后病例的管理,特别是对于未接种疫苗的个体。需要进行临床试验来验证这些策略,并考虑将其纳入未来的全球 麻疹 消除计划。

title: Measles immunity in a large urban population in Northeast Brazil: a population-based assessment using PRNT and ELISA.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Waning measles immunity in post-elimination settings may increase susceptibility and facilitate viral reintroduction. This study assessed measles immunity in an urban population in Northeast Brazil using neutralizing antibody testing and IgG serology. METHODS: A population-based seroprevalence study was conducted in 2024 among residents aged ≥2 years in 30 sentinel areas of Salvador, Brazil. Measles-specific IgG antibodies were measured by ELISA in all participants, and neutralizing antibodies were assessed by plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) in a stratified subsample (n=671). Seroprevalence was estimated by age group. Agreement between ELISA and PRNT was evaluated using Cohen's kappa, and factors associated with PRNT positivity were examined using logistic regression adjusted for age and sex. RESULTS: Among participants, 60.8% were female and 38.3% were aged ≥50 years. Overall seroprevalence was 91.4% by PRNT and 85.4% by ELISA, with 86.3% agreement between assays (kappa = 0.34, p < 0.001). The highest PRNT seropositivity was observed among individuals aged 10-19 years and ≥50 years, whereas the highest PRNT seronegativity occurred among young adults aged 20-29 years (23.4%). In adjusted analyses, children and adolescents aged 5-19 years had lower odds of PRNT positivity compared with those aged 2-4 years. No significant differences were observed by sex. CONCLUSIONS: Despite high overall seroprevalence, relevant immunity gaps were identified, particularly among young adults, indicating increased susceptibility to measles in this urban population. The combined use of PRNT and ELISA highlights the need for targeted vaccination strategies in post-elimination urban settings.

abstract_zh: 目的:消除后环境中 麻疹 免疫力的减弱可能会增加易感性并促进病毒重新引入。本研究使用中和抗体测试和 IgG 血清学 评估了巴西东北部城市人口的 麻疹 免疫力。方法:2024 年,在巴西萨尔瓦多 30 个哨点地区的 2 岁以上居民中开展了一项基于人群的 血清流行率 研究。通过 ELISA 测量所有参与者的 麻疹 特异性 IgG 抗体,并通过分层子样本 (n=671) 中的空斑减少中和试验 (PRNT) 评估中和抗体。血清流行率 按年龄组估计。使用 Cohen's kappa 评估 ELISA 和 PRNT 之间的一致性,并使用调整年龄和性别的逻辑回归检查与 PRNT 阳性相关的因素。结果:参与者中,60.8%为女性,38.3%年龄≥50岁。PRNT 的总体 血清流行率 为 91.4%,ELISA 的总体 血清流行率 为 85.4%,测定之间的一致性为 86.3%(kappa = 0.34,p < 0.001)。PRNT 血清阳性率最高的人群为 10-19 岁和 50 岁以上人群,而最高的 PRNT 血清阴性人群为 20-29 岁的年轻人 (23.4%)。在调整后的分析中,5-19 岁的儿童和青少年 PRNT 阳性的几率低于 2-4 岁的儿童和青少年。没有观察到性别之间的显着差异。结论:尽管 血清流行率 总体较高,但仍发现了相关的免疫差距,特别是在年轻人中,表明该城市人群对 麻疹 的易感性增加。PRNT 和 ELISA 的结合使用凸显了在消除后城市环境中采取有针对性的 疫苗接种 策略的必要性。

title: Five-year descriptive epidemiology of measles in Punjab, Pakistan, 2022–2026: trends, age distribution, and geographic burden; a retrospective surveillance study
abstract: Measles resurgences following the COVID-19 pandemic have placed millions of unvaccinated children at risk across South Asia. Punjab, Pakistan’s most populous province with approximately 125 million residents, experienced a sustained measles epidemic from 2022 to 2024. This study describes the five-year epidemiology of measles in Punjab using individual-level surveillance data from the provincial Expanded Program on Immunization (EPI) surveillance system. We conducted a retrospective descriptive analysis of 72,565 suspected measles case records from the Punjab EPI VPD surveillance line-list, epidemiological week 1 of 2022 through epidemiological week 23 of 2026. Variables analyzed included case counts, incidence rates per 100,000 population, age at illness onset, sex, vaccination status, case outcomes, and district-level geographic distribution. District-level population denominators adjusted for annual growth were applied to calculate incidence rates. Statistical analysis used the Cochran-Armitage trend test, Wilson 95% confidence intervals, and Spearman rank correlation. Reported measles cases escalated from 6,613 in 2022 to a peak of 23,623 in 2024 (incidence 18.92 per 100,000 population), before declining to 19,913 in 2025 and 9,898 through week 23 of 2026. Overall, 184 deaths were recorded (case fatality ratio [CFR] 0.25%). Male cases predominated (57–58% annually; M:F ratio 1.40:1). The proportion of infants under 12 months rose from 37.3% (95% CI 36.2–38.5%) in 2022 to 47.9% (95% CI 46.9–48.9%) in 2026 (Cochran-Armitage z = 12.77, p < 0.0001), with median age at infection declining from 18 months (IQR 8–42) to 12 months (IQR 7–36). Zero-dose cases peaked at 49.6% (95% CI 49.0–50.2%) in 2024 (z = 3.37, p = 0.0008). Chiniot (62.95 per 100,000) and Jhang (59.98 per 100,000) bore the highest district incidence in 2024. Reported first-dose measles-containing vaccine (MCV1) coverage was paradoxically positively correlated with district measles incidence (Spearman rho = + 0.370, p = 0.027), consistent with surveillance activity bias. Punjab experienced a measles epidemic peaking in 2024, with 72,565 reported suspected cases and 184 deaths across 2022 to 2026, driven by accumulation of unvaccinated children within districts reporting nominally high MCV1 coverage. The progressive shift in disease burden toward infants under 12 months demands renewed focus on vaccination system quality, zero-dose outreach, and surveillance sensitivity. These findings are relevant to other high-burden EMRO settings facing similar immunization system challenges.

title: EPIDEMIOLOGICAL PROFILE OF MEASLES HOSPITALIZATIONS IN BRAZIL FROM 2020 TO 2025
abstract: Objective: To analyze the epidemiological profile of hospital admissions due to measles in Brazil from 2020 to 2025. Methods: This was an ecological, descriptive, retrospective study based on secondary data from the Hospital Information System of the Brazilian Unified Health System (SIH/SUS), available through DATASUS/TABNET. Hospital admissions, deaths, and mortality rates were analyzed according to year, geographic region, sex, race/ethnicity, and age group, considering measles as the primary diagnosis (ICD-10 B05). Results: A total of 940 hospital admissions and eight deaths were recorded during the study period. A marked reduction in hospital admissions was observed between 2020 and 2023, followed by a slight increase in 2024 and 2025. The North region accounted for the highest proportion of hospitalizations (58.62%), while children under 1 year of age had the highest number of admissions, followed by those aged 1 to 4 years. The highest proportional mortality was observed among individuals aged 80 years or older. Hospitalizations were similarly distributed between sexes, with a predominance of the brown race/ethnicity category among records with available information. Conclusion: Measles-related hospital admissions decreased substantially during the study period; however, the persistence of hospitalizations and the increase observed in recent years highlight the need to maintain high vaccination coverage, continuous epidemiological surveillance, timely diagnosis, and ongoing training of healthcare professionals to prevent viral reintroduction and sustained transmission in Brazil.

title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
journal: CAUCHY: Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. title: Fuzzy based Mathematical Model of Measles with Double-Dose Vaccination under Epidemiological Parameter Uncertainty
abstract: This study develops a fuzzy-based mathematical model for the transmission dynamics of measles incorporating double-dose vaccination and treatment under epidemiological parameter uncertainty. The model extends a deterministic measles framework by representing selected parameters, including the transmission, vaccination, treatment and recovery rates, as triangular fuzzy numbers. Basic properties of the model are established, and the disease-free equilibrium and basic reproduction number are derived. The $r$-cut approach is employed to obtain interval-valued representations of the uncertain parameters and the fuzzy basic reproduction number. The results show that the uncertainty interval of the reproduction number decreases as the $r$-cut level increases and converges to the deterministic reproduction number at $r=1$. Intervention analysis further shows that a combined reduction in disease transmission with increased vaccination coverage and treatment can reduce both the deterministic reproduction number and the upper bound of the fuzzy reproduction number below unity. The proposed framework therefore provides a useful approach for assessing measles transmission and control when epidemiological parameters are imprecisely known.

title: Measles, Mumps, and Rubella - Persistence of Immunity After Childhood Vaccination in Australian Health Science Students
abstract: Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (MMR) continue to pose global public health risks, and immunity among undergraduate health science students is essential to ensure safe clinical placement and workforce readiness. Despite high childhood vaccination coverage, emerging evidence suggests that some young adults may have incomplete, waning, or uncertain immunity. This program of research aimed to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of the MMR vaccine from childhood through to adulthood among undergraduate health science students. Three studies explored biological, behavioural, and system-level contributors to immunity gaps. Paper 1 used a scoping review methodology to map how the nurse practitioner (NP) immuniser role is conceptualised within primary healthcare (PHC). The review found that although NPs frequently deliver vaccination-related care, their role in immunisation assessment and follow-up is under-recognised, revealing opportunities for NPled models to address barriers and improve vaccine communication. Paper 2 used a quantitative cohort study, using the Vaccine Effectiveness Framework, to compare Australian Immunisation Register (AIR) records with serological testing among domestic and international students. Discrepancies were identified between documented vaccination and actual immune status, including students with complete AIR records who lacked serological immunity, providing evidence of waning immunity and limitations of relying solely on administrative records. Paper 3 used a quantitative cross-sectional survey informed by the Health Belief Model (HBM) to examine students’ knowledge, attitudes, and beliefs about MMR diseases, vaccination, and immunity testing. Knowledge gaps, low perceived susceptibility, misconceptions about lifelong immunity, and difficulty interpreting vaccination records were strongly associated with reduced intention to check immunity, highlighting the need for structured education within health science programs. Together, these studies demonstrate that immunity gaps arise from the intersection of biological waning immunity, incomplete or unreliable records, and behavioural influences on vaccine decisionmaking. This program of research fills a critical gap by integrating biological, behavioural, and system level evidence and demonstrates the potential for NP-led immunisation models to strengthen assessment, communication, and follow-up in primary healthcare. The findings offer practical strategies to improve vaccine literacy, immunity monitoring, and long-term immunity among future healthcare professionals.

title_zh: 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 - 澳大利亚健康科学学生在童年后的免疫力 麻疹 的持续性
source_body_en: Measles, Mumps, and Rubella (MMR) continue to pose global public health risks, and immunity among undergraduate health science students is essential to ensure safe clinical placement and workforce readiness. Despite high childhood vaccination coverage, emerging evidence suggests that some young adults may have incomplete, waning, or uncertain immunity. This program of research aimed to evaluate the long-term effectiveness of the MMR vaccine from childhood through to adulthood among undergraduate health science students. Three studies explored biological, behavioural, and system-level contributors to immunity gaps. Paper 1 used a scoping review methodology to map how the nurse practitioner (NP) immuniser role is conceptualised within primary healthcare (PHC). The review found that although NPs frequently deliver vaccination-related care, their role in immunisation assessment and follow-up is under-recognised, revealing opportunities for NPled models to address barriers and improve vaccine communication. Paper 2 used a quantitative cohort study, using the Vaccine Effectiveness Framework, to compare Australian Immunisation Register (AIR) records with serological testing among domestic and international students. Discrepancies were identified between documented vaccination and actual immune status, including students with complete AIR records who lacked serological immunity, providing evidence of waning immunity and limitations of relying solely on administrative records. Paper 3 used a quantitative cross-sectional survey informed by the Health Belief Model (HBM) to examine students’ knowledge, attitudes, and beliefs about MMR diseases, vaccination, and immunity testing. Knowledge gaps, low perceived susceptibility, misconceptions about lifelong immunity, and difficulty interpreting vaccination records were strongly associated with reduced intention to check immunity, highlighting the need for structured education within health science programs. Together, these studies demonstrate that immunity gaps arise from the intersection of biological waning immunity, incomplete or unreliable records, and behavioural influences on vaccine decisionmaking. This program of research fills a critical gap by integrating biological, behavioural, and system level evidence and demonstrates the potential for NP-led immunisation models to strengthen assessment, communication, and follow-up in primary healthcare. The findings offer practical strategies to improve vaccine literacy, immunity monitoring, and long-term immunity among future healthcare professionals.
abstract_zh: 麻疹、腮腺炎和风疹 (MMR) 继续构成全球公共卫生风险,本科健康科学专业学生的免疫力对于确保安全的临床安置和劳动力准备至关重要。尽管儿童期 疫苗接种 覆盖率很高,但新出现的证据表明,一些年轻人的免疫力可能不完整、减弱或不确定。该研究计划旨在评估 MMR 疫苗 对本科健康科学学生从童年到成年的长期有效性。三项研究探讨了造成免疫缺陷的生物学、行为和系统层面的因素。论文 1 使用范围界定审查方法来描绘如何在初级保健 (PHC) 中概念化执业护士 (NP) 免疫者的角色。审查发现,尽管 NP 经常提供 疫苗接种 相关护理,但他们在免疫评估和随访中的作用并未得到充分认识,这揭示了 NPled 模型解决障碍和改善 疫苗 沟通的机会。论文 2 采用了一项定量 队列研究 研究,使用 疫苗 有效性框架,将澳大利亚免疫登记册 (AIR) 记录与国内和国际学生的血清学检测进行比较。记录的 疫苗接种 与实际免疫状态之间存在差异,包括拥有完整 AIR 记录但缺乏血清学免疫力的学生,这提供了免疫力减弱的证据以及仅依赖管理记录的局限性。论文 3 采用健康信念模型 (HBM) 为基础的定量横断面调查来考察学生对 MMR 疾病、疫苗接种 和免疫检测的知识、态度和信念。知识差距、感知敏感性低、对终身免疫力的误解以及解释 疫苗接种 记录的困难与检查免疫力的意愿降低密切相关,这凸显了在健康科学项目中进行结构化教育的必要性。这些研究共同表明,免疫差距是由于生物免疫力减弱、记录不完整或不可靠以及行为对 疫苗 决策的影响等因素的交叉作用而产生的。该研究计划通过整合生物、行为和系统级证据填补了一个关键空白,并展示了 NP 主导的免疫模型在加强初级卫生保健评估、沟通和随访方面的潜力。研究结果为提高未来医疗保健专业人员的 疫苗 素养、免疫监测和长期免疫力提供了实用策略。

title: The 2026 Measles Outbreak in Bangladesh: A Critique of Immunity Gaps and Care Deficiencies
abstract: Bangladesh entered 2026 amid a severe measles outbreak that peaked in mid-May. This article analyses the public health response to the outbreak and evaluates the government's management of the crisis. Health professionals and measles experts have attributed the outbreak to accumulated gaps in routine immunisation, weaknesses in public health infrastructure, poor nutritional status among children, widespread vitamin A deficiency, and maternal undernutrition during pregnancy and breastfeeding.

title: [Fever and rash after international travel: two cases of vaccine failure].
abstract: Measles cases in Germany are predominantly imported or import-associated. Two returning travelers with measles vaccine failure are reported: a 49-year-old male with primary vaccine failure after single-dose vaccination who developed severe measles pneumonitis, and a 22-year-old male with secondary vaccine failure in the context of suspected immunodeficiency who presented with a mild course and atypical exanthem. Measles remains a relevant differential diagnosis even in vaccinated individuals, and travel medicine consultations should routinely include an assessment of measles vaccination status.

title: Time, place, person: Field epidemiology as a political practice.
abstract: Five years after the end of the Ebola epidemic, a district in Sierra Leone received a measles alert. This article tells the story of the epidemic that followed and the response that was mounted in the context of the new global epidemic preparedness and biosecurity paradigms that govern the management of health emergencies. Focusing on the daily encounters that constitute outbreak investigations and the narratives, negotiations and contestations that emerge from these interactions, allows us to envision field epidemiology as a political practice. This means seeing how global epidemiological logics converge with local politics and forms of exclusion. Efforts to make epidemics knowable and responding to them, then, reshape political relations, governing citizens and ordering relations between levels of public health governance. At the same time, as field epidemiological work becomes entangled in local political negotiations, it also generates new spaces for contestation, resistance and repair.

title_zh: 时间、地点、人物:作为政治实践的领域流行病学。
source_body_en: Five years after the end of the Ebola epidemic, a district in Sierra Leone received a measles alert. This article tells the story of the epidemic that followed and the response that was mounted in the context of the new global epidemic preparedness and biosecurity paradigms that govern the management of health emergencies. Focusing on the daily encounters that constitute outbreak investigations and the narratives, negotiations and contestations that emerge from these interactions, allows us to envision field epidemiology as a political practice. This means seeing how global epidemiological logics converge with local politics and forms of exclusion. Efforts to make epidemics knowable and responding to them, then, reshape political relations, governing citizens and ordering relations between levels of public health governance. At the same time, as field epidemiological work becomes entangled in local political negotiations, it also generates new spaces for contestation, resistance and repair.

title: Reproducibility and validity failures in systematic review deduplication tools: evaluation on a paediatric neuroradiology corpus.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Deduplication is usually treated as a routine preprocessing step in systematic reviews, yet errors introduced at this stage are not visible in Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) flow diagrams and can propagate through evidence synthesis. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate the validity and reproducibility of commonly used deduplication tools in a paediatric neuroradiology systematic review. MATERIALS AND METHODS: PubMed and Embase were searched for peer-reviewed literature on paediatric subacute sclerosing panencephalitis neuroimaging, yielding 603 records. Two reviewers independently deduplicated the combined corpus using Zotero (version 8.0.4) and Rayyan (updated 21 January 2026). A manual reference standard was established by dual-reviewer adjudication of potential duplicate pairs using title, publication year, author list, and Digital Object Identifier (DOI). Tool outputs were compared against this reference standard for false-positive and false-negative decisions and for reproducibility across runs. RESULTS: Manual adjudication identified 120 true duplicate records, leaving 483 unique records. Zotero produced identical outputs across reviewers, indicating deterministic behaviour, but generated 16 false-positive duplicate decisions and 5 false negatives, predominantly related to DOI collision. Rayyan identified more true duplicates but produced non-identical outputs across independent runs, with 16-17 false positives and 1 false negative per run. CONCLUSION: Commonly used deduplication tools can introduce either deterministic bias or non-deterministic record loss before screening begins. In paediatric radiology evidence synthesis, the deduplication software version and verification strategy should be explicitly reported. Auditable secondary checks should be considered before records are removed.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 麻疹病毒(人麻疹病毒)、风疹和 麻疹 疾病等历史名称,以及 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 等相关病症。核心问题是系统评价中重复数据删除工具的有效性和可重复性,特别是在儿科神经放射学背景下。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述使用儿科神经放射学语料库评估了重复数据删除工具。检索了 PubMed 和 Embase 中有关儿科 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 神经影像学的文献,结果有 603 条记录。两名审阅者使用 Zotero(版本 8.0.4)和 Rayyan(2026 年 1 月 21 日更新)独立对记录进行重复数据删除。通过双审稿人根据标题、出版年份、作者列表和 DOI 对潜在的重复对进行裁决,建立了手动参考标准。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 人工裁定识别出120条真正的重复记录,剩余483条唯一记录。Zotero表现出确定性行为,但有16条假阳性与5条假阴性判断,主要由于DOI冲突。Rayyan识别出更多真正的重复记录,但不同运行之间的输出不一致,每次运行有16-17条假阳性与1条假阴性。综述得出结论,去重工具可能在筛选开始前引入确定性偏差或非确定性记录丢失。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于重复数据删除工具的可靠性存在争议,因为它们可能会产生不一致或有偏差的结果。该审查强调了在儿科放射学证据合成中明确报告重复数据删除软件版本和验证策略的必要性。证据还指出了这些工具在再现性和有效性方面的差距,特别是在处理 DOI 冲突和确保运行中的一致输出方面。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查建议在删除记录之前应考虑进行可审计的二次检查。它强调报告重复数据删除方法和软件版本的透明度的重要性,以确保系统审查的可重复性和有效性。此外,它还强调需要进一步研究提高重复数据删除工具的准确性,特别是在处理 DOI 冲突等复杂情况时。

analysis_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述重点关注 麻疹病毒(人麻疹病毒)、风疹和 麻疹 疾病等历史名称,以及 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 等相关病症。核心问题是系统评价中重复数据删除工具的有效性和可重复性,特别是在儿科神经放射学背景下。
analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述使用儿科神经放射学语料库评估了重复数据删除工具。检索了 PubMed 和 Embase 中有关儿科 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 神经影像学的文献,结果有 603 条记录。两名审阅者使用 Zotero(版本 8.0.4)和 Rayyan(2026 年 1 月 21 日更新)独立对记录进行重复数据删除。通过双审稿人根据标题、出版年份、作者列表和 DOI 对潜在的重复对进行裁决,建立了手动参考标准。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 人工裁定识别出120条真正的重复记录,剩余483条唯一记录。Zotero表现出确定性行为,但有16条假阳性与5条假阴性判断,主要由于DOI冲突。Rayyan识别出更多真正的重复记录,但不同运行之间的输出不一致,每次运行有16-17条假阳性与1条假阴性。综述得出结论,去重工具可能在筛选开始前引入确定性偏差或非确定性记录丢失。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 关于重复数据删除工具的可靠性存在争议,因为它们可能会产生不一致或有偏差的结果。该审查强调了在儿科放射学证据合成中明确报告重复数据删除软件版本和验证策略的必要性。证据还指出了这些工具在再现性和有效性方面的差距,特别是在处理 DOI 冲突和确保运行中的一致输出方面。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 审查建议在删除记录之前应考虑进行可审计的二次检查。它强调报告重复数据删除方法和软件版本的透明度的重要性,以确保系统审查的可重复性和有效性。此外,它还强调需要进一步研究提高重复数据删除工具的准确性,特别是在处理 DOI 冲突等复杂情况时。

title: The Relationship Between Political Affiliation, Perceptions of Science and Scientists, and Perceived Safety and Effectiveness of the MMR, Flu, and COVID-19 Vaccines: United States, 2024.
abstract: To examine the associations between political party identification, perceptions of science and scientists, and perceived safety and effectiveness of the measles, mumps, and rubella, flu, and COVID-19 vaccines. We used multiple regression analyses to examine survey data collected in November 2024 from a national probability sample of 1763 US adults. We measured perceptions of science and scientists using the Factors Assessing Science's Self-Presentation (FASS) scale, which assesses beliefs that scientists are credible, prudent, and unbiased and that science is beneficial and self-correcting. Respondents perceived the measles, mumps, and rubella vaccine as the safest and most effective (mean safety score = 3.54 [SD = 0.71]; mean effectiveness score = 3.63 [SD = 0.68]) and the COVID-19 vaccine as the least safe and effective (mean safety score = 2.98 [SD = 1.07]; mean effectiveness score = 2.81 [SD = 1.02]). After adjustment for FASS factors, political party identification was associated only with perceptions of the COVID-19 vaccine (P < .001). Associations between political party identification and FASS factors varied by vaccine type. Perceiving science as beneficial was the factor most consistently associated with vaccine evaluations. Republicans are more concerned about the safety and effectiveness of vaccines, with politicization most evident for the COVID-19 vaccine. Public Health Implications. These findings can guide tailored communication strategies addressing vaccine safety and effectiveness concerns among specific audiences. (Am J Public Health. Published online ahead of print September 10, 2026:e1-e9. https://doi.org/10.2105/AJPH.2026.308606).

title: Fragmented criticality of infectious disease epidemics
abstract: Population vulnerability to an infectious disease epidemic is commonly summarized by system-level indicators such as the epidemic threshold: a single critical boundary. Yet transmission is heterogeneous across communities, host groups and transmission pathways, and public-health decisions often require identifying which parts of the system become vulnerable, and under which conditions. Here we show that epidemic criticality can itself be fragmented across population structure. Using multitype branching processes, we identify singularities governing the expected size of outbreaks that ultimately become extinct and show that coupling between population strata transforms their individual thresholds into complex-valued critical points. Their real parts locate critical changes along the transmissibility axis, their imaginary parts determine their strength and smearing, and their modes identify the subpopulations involved. In Italy, this framework reveals localized vulnerability to respiratory-pathogen emergence and improves vaccine allocation over importation-based strategies. For measles in Texas, it identifies spatial units more homogeneous in observed outbreak burden than standard administrative or metropolitan partitions. In a One Health model of livestock-associated MRSA, it separates occupational and human--animal transmission pathways. Epidemic vulnerability is therefore organized by a structured critical landscape rather than a single threshold, and resolving this landscape can directly inform public-health risk assessment and intervention.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to understand how population vulnerability to infectious disease epidemics is structured, moving beyond the traditional single epidemic threshold to account for heterogeneity in transmission across communities, host groups and pathways. The research question focuses on whether epidemic criticality can be fragmented across population structure.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employs a theoretical framework using multitype branching processes to analyze epidemic criticality across different population structures. It examines measles in Texas, Italy and livestock-associated MRSA as case studies, highlighting the application of this framework to diverse contexts.
analysis.methods: The authors use multitype branching processes to model and identify singularities that govern the expected size of outbreaks. They analyze these models to determine how coupling between population strata transforms individual thresholds into complex-valued critical points, with real and imaginary parts representing different aspects of vulnerability.
analysis.main_results: The framework identifies spatial units in Texas that are more homogeneous in outbreak burden than standard administrative or metropolitan partitions. In Italy, it reveals localized vulnerability to respiratory-pathogen emergence and demonstrates improved vaccine allocation strategies over importation-based ones.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret their findings as evidence that epidemic vulnerability is organized by a structured critical landscape rather than a single threshold. This approach provides a novel method for public-health risk assessment and intervention by resolving the complex dynamics of criticality across population subgroups.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a new perspective for understanding and managing infectious disease risks by identifying localized vulnerabilities and improving targeted interventions such as vaccine allocation. This could enhance surveillance and response strategies in public health.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical modeling and case studies, which may not fully capture real-world complexities. However, the framework is supported by explicit lexical evidence and applied to specific contexts, providing a moderate level of confidence in its implications.

analysis.summary_en: This study explores the fragmented nature of epidemic criticality across population structures, challenging the traditional view of a single epidemic threshold. Using multitype branching processes, the authors demonstrate how coupling between population strata transforms individual thresholds into complex-valued critical points, with real and imaginary parts indicating different aspects of vulnerability. The framework is applied to measles in Texas, Italy, and livestock-associated MRSA, revealing localized vulnerabilities and more homogeneous spatial units than standard administrative partitions. It also highlights improved vaccine allocation strategies in Italy. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that epidemic vulnerability is structured by a critical landscape, offering a novel approach for public-health risk assessment and intervention. While the study is theoretical and based on case studies, the results are supported by explicit lexical evidence, providing a moderate level of confidence in their implications for managing infectious disease risks.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to understand how population vulnerability to infectious disease epidemics is structured, moving beyond the traditional single epidemic threshold to account for heterogeneity in transmission across communities, host groups and pathways. The research question focuses on whether epidemic criticality can be fragmented across population structure.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study employs a theoretical framework using multitype branching processes to analyze epidemic criticality across different population structures. It examines measles in Texas, Italy and livestock-associated MRSA as case studies, highlighting the application of this framework to diverse contexts.
elements_en.methods: The authors use multitype branching processes to model and identify singularities that govern the expected size of outbreaks. They analyze these models to determine how coupling between population strata transforms individual thresholds into complex-valued critical points, with real and imaginary parts representing different aspects of vulnerability.
elements_en.main_results: The framework identifies spatial units in Texas that are more homogeneous in outbreak burden than standard administrative or metropolitan partitions. In Italy, it reveals localized vulnerability to respiratory-pathogen emergence and demonstrates improved vaccine allocation strategies over importation-based ones.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret their findings as evidence that epidemic vulnerability is organized by a structured critical landscape rather than a single threshold. This approach provides a novel method for public-health risk assessment and intervention by resolving the complex dynamics of criticality across population subgroups.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a new perspective for understanding and managing infectious disease risks by identifying localized vulnerabilities and improving targeted interventions such as vaccine allocation. This could enhance surveillance and response strategies in public health.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to theoretical modeling and case studies, which may not fully capture real-world complexities. However, the framework is supported by explicit lexical evidence and applied to specific contexts, providing a moderate level of confidence in its implications.

title_zh: 传染病流行的关键性碎片化
source_body_en: Population vulnerability to an infectious disease epidemic is commonly summarized by system-level indicators such as the epidemic threshold: a single critical boundary. Yet transmission is heterogeneous across communities, host groups and transmission pathways, and public-health decisions often require identifying which parts of the system become vulnerable, and under which conditions. Here we show that epidemic criticality can itself be fragmented across population structure. Using multitype branching processes, we identify singularities governing the expected size of outbreaks that ultimately become extinct and show that coupling between population strata transforms their individual thresholds into complex-valued critical points. Their real parts locate critical changes along the transmissibility axis, their imaginary parts determine their strength and smearing, and their modes identify the subpopulations involved. In Italy, this framework reveals localized vulnerability to respiratory-pathogen emergence and improves vaccine allocation over importation-based strategies. For measles in Texas, it identifies spatial units more homogeneous in observed outbreak burden than standard administrative or metropolitan partitions. In a One Health model of livestock-associated MRSA, it separates occupational and human--animal transmission pathways. Epidemic vulnerability is therefore organized by a structured critical landscape rather than a single threshold, and resolving this landscape can directly inform public-health risk assessment and intervention.
abstract_zh: 人群对传染病流行的高度易感性通常通过系统级指标(如流行阈值)来总结:一个单一的关键边界。然而,传播在不同社区、宿主群体和传播路径中表现出异质性,公共卫生决策往往需要确定哪些系统部分变得易感,以及在何种条件下发生。本文展示流行关键性本身可能在人口结构中碎片化。通过多类型分支过程,我们识别出决定暴发最终灭绝规模的奇点,并表明人口群体之间的耦合会将各自的阈值转化为复数关键点。这些关键点的实部确定了沿传播力轴的关键变化,虚部决定了其强度和模糊性,而其模式则识别了涉及的亚群体。在意大利,该框架揭示了对呼吸道病原体出现的局部易感性,并在基于输入的策略之上改进了疫苗的分配。对于麻疹在德克萨斯州的分析,它识别出比标准行政或都市划分更同质化的空间单位。在一项与畜牧业相关的耐甲氧西林金黄色葡萄球菌(MRSA)的One Health模型中,它区分了职业性和人-动物传播传播路径。因此,流行病的易感性是由一个结构化的关键景观组织的,而不是单一的阈值。解析这一景观可以直接为公共卫生风险评估和干预提供信息。

title: High Second Year Immunisation Coverage Alongside Persistent Newer Vaccine Hesitancy: A Mixed-Methods Study in Three Districts of Malawi
abstract: Background: /Objectives: The Immunisation Agenda 2030 places sustained coverage and vaccine confidence at the centre of immunisation strategy. Less is known about the determinants of sec-ond-year-of-life vaccine uptake in sub-Saharan Africa. This study assessed the completion of vac-cines due after 12 months of age, caregiver confidence in newly introduced vaccines, and the factors associated with completion in three districts of Malawi. Methods: A mixed-methods cross-sectional survey of 1,177 caregivers in Chikwawa, Kasungu, and Mangochi assessed household wealth, food insecurity, and vaccination status. The primary outcome was caregiver-reported completion of all vaccines due after 12 months, assessed among children aged 18 months or older. Associations were examined using logistic regression. Focus group discussions with caregivers and key-informant in-terviews with community volunteers and leaders were then analysed thematically to explain the survey findings. Results: Among 1287 age-eligible children,1212 (94.2%) had completed second-year vaccines. Coverage ranged from about 94% for the measles-rubella vaccine to 61% for the Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine. Completion did not differ by household wealth, food insecurity, distance, or caregiver literacy. Health worker reminders were associated with vaccine completion (adjusted odds ratio 0.33, 95% confidence interval 0.17 to 0.62) Infertility concerns about the HPV vaccine were the most commonly reported concern (20.3 %). After excluding age-ineligibility, lack of vaccine awareness was the main reason for children missing newer vaccines. Conclusions: Sec-ond-year coverage was high and equitable. The main modifiable correlate of completion was health worker reminders and follow-up, a function that appears to be under-resourced.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在评估马拉维三个地区儿童在12个月大之后应接种的疫苗完成情况以及与完成率相关的因素,以填补撒哈拉以南非洲地区第二年疫苗接种率决定因素的知识空白。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对奇夸瓦、卡松古和曼戈切的 1,177 名护理人员进行了混合方法横断面调查,以评估家庭财富、粮食不安全和 疫苗接种 状况。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用逻辑回归来检查关联性,并进行焦点小组讨论和关键知情人访谈来解释调查结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 1,287 名符合年龄条件的儿童中,94.2% 完成了第二年 疫苗,覆盖范围从 麻疹-风疹 疫苗 的 94% 到人乳头瘤病毒 (HPV) 疫苗 的 61%。卫生工作者提醒与 疫苗 的完成相关,而有关 HPV 疫苗 的不孕问题是最常报告的问题。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 本研究发现第二年的疫苗接种覆盖率高且公平,卫生工作者的提醒是完成率的一个可修改相关因素。主要的新发现是卫生工作者的提醒与疫苗完成率之间的关联。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为监测和疫苗接种策略提供信息,特别是在解决疫苗犹豫和确保公平覆盖率方面。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其横断面设计以及回忆偏差的潜在影响。由于研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

title: Supply-Side Bottlenecks of Newly Introduced and Second-Year-of-Life Vaccines in Malawi: From Vaccine Availability to Delivery
abstract: Introduction: Existing evidence on why children miss vaccines after infancy has focused on the demand side, focusing on the attitudes and circumstances of caregivers. The supply side, meaning the system’s capacity to make vaccines available, accessible, and deliverable, has received less attention, even though it determines whether a willing caregiver can be served. This study examined the supply-side determinants of second-year and newer vaccine uptake in Malawi through a coverage-cascade and bottleneck analysis. Methods: A mixed-methods study drew on a caregiver survey, a survey of frontline health workers, a facility checklist and data quality assessment, and key-informant interviews at facility, district, and national level. Findings were organised through the Tanahashi coverage framework, which follows the steps from the availability of commodities and staff, through geographic access, to service contact and effective coverage. Supply-side constraints in uptake were profiled at each step and set against the coverage achieved for each antigen. Results: Effective coverage fell across the antigen sequence, from 95.9 percent for the second dose of measles-rubella vaccine and 93.1 percent for the second dose of polio vaccine, to 74.6 percent for typhoid, to 63 percent for HPV. Commodity availability was high, with cold chain and vaccines present in every checklist facility, and stock records in 47 of 50, yet a quarter of caregivers had been turned away due to stockouts. Human-resource readiness was weaker, with over half of frontline workers never receiving refresher training. Geographic access constrained a fifth of caregivers, and outreach, though present everywhere, was limited by fuel and, in staff accounts, reduced by the 2025 withdrawal of external funding. The bottleneck was not commodity availability but the contact step and the maintenance of frontline capacity. National respondents placed these constraints within a financing system that is partly donor-dependent and fragmented across separate partner plans. Conclusions: The supply system delivered the established second-year antigens well and faltered for the newer ones and at the point of contact. Sustaining uptake will require protecting stock at the point of need, resourcing outreach, maintaining frontline capacity, and adapting supply for the newer vaccines.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 供应端,即系统能否使疫苗可获得、可访问并可配送,却较少受到关注,尽管它决定了愿意接种的照顾者是否能够被服务。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用混合方法研究,结合照顾者调查、一线卫生工作者调查、设施清单检查和数据质量评估,以及在设施、区级和国家级层面进行的关键人物访谈。
elements_zh.methods: 在每个步骤中,对疫苗接种率的供应端限制进行了分析,并与每种抗原的覆盖情况进行了对比。
elements_zh.main_results: 疫苗可获得性较高,冷链设备和疫苗在所有检查设施中均有配备,且在50个设施中有47个记录了库存情况,但仍有四分之一的照顾者因缺货而被拒绝接种。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 国家级受访者将这些限制归因于一个部分依赖捐助方、且在不同合作伙伴计划之间分散的融资体系。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 供应系统能够良好地提供已建立的第二年抗原,但在新抗原和接触环节表现不佳。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 维持接种率需要保护接种点的库存,为推广活动提供资源,维持一线人员能力,并为新疫苗调整供应体系。

title: Whole-genome analysis of mumps virus genotype F in Shandong, China (2006–2018)
abstract: Introduction Despite the introduction of mumps-containing vaccines into the routine immunization program in 2008, mumps incidence in Shandong Province, China, declined but remained substantially higher than that of measles and rubella, and above WHO elimination thresholds, raising the possibility of whether genetic evolution of circulating strains has contributed to this phenomenon. To address, we compared mumps viruses isolated pre-vaccine (2006–2007) and a decade after rollout (2018). Methods We analyzed mumps case data reported in Shandong from 2005 to 2024. We also performed whole-genome sequencing on 16 mumps virus strains isolated during the same period. Phylogenetic analyses were conducted to characterize viral genetic features and identify mutations. Results From 2005 to 2024, 167,590 mumps cases were reported, peaking in 2012 (25.33 per 100,000 population). SH-gene typing consistently identified all 16 strains as genotype F, a result corroborated by whole-genome phylogeny; however, the SH gene alone proved insufficient for phylogenetic resolution among closely related strains, consistent with the value of whole-genome sequencing for epidemiological surveillance. The 16 full-length genomes shared 98.34–100% nucleotide identity. Phylogenetic analysis revealed intermingling of 2006–2007 and 2018 isolates rather than time-specific clustering, with low inter-group p-distances. Importantly, between the two temporal groups, no significant differences were detected in their respective identities to the vaccine strain S79 at the whole-genome level (nucleotide or amino acid). Two positively selected sites were identified across the seven structural proteins (posterior probability > 0.95). Eight mutations in HN and F that alter hydrophilicity, hydrophobicity, or charge were found, but structural modeling predicted no appreciable conformational changes. Conclusion We provides a whole-genome-based, two-time point comparison of genotype F mumps viruses in Shandong across a ~ 12-year interval spanning vaccine introduction (2006–2007 vs. Overall, the Shandong 2018 isolates remained as similar to the 2006–2007 isolates as F strains are nationwide, and both groups were comparably close to vaccine strain S79, indicating no detectable genetic divergence or drift over the ~12-year period. As the SH gene alone lacked sufficient diversity to resolve closely related isolates, whole-genome sequencing provided more accurate genetic characterization in this study.

title_zh: 中国山东省2006–2018年流行性腮腺炎病毒基因型F的全基因组分析
source_body_en: Introduction Despite the introduction of mumps-containing vaccines into the routine immunization program in 2008, mumps incidence in Shandong Province, China, declined but remained substantially higher than that of measles and rubella, and above WHO elimination thresholds, raising the possibility of whether genetic evolution of circulating strains has contributed to this phenomenon. To address, we compared mumps viruses isolated pre-vaccine (2006–2007) and a decade after rollout (2018). Methods We analyzed mumps case data reported in Shandong from 2005 to 2024. We also performed whole-genome sequencing on 16 mumps virus strains isolated during the same period. Phylogenetic analyses were conducted to characterize viral genetic features and identify mutations. Results From 2005 to 2024, 167,590 mumps cases were reported, peaking in 2012 (25.33 per 100,000 population). SH-gene typing consistently identified all 16 strains as genotype F, a result corroborated by whole-genome phylogeny; however, the SH gene alone proved insufficient for phylogenetic resolution among closely related strains, consistent with the value of whole-genome sequencing for epidemiological surveillance. The 16 full-length genomes shared 98.34–100% nucleotide identity. Phylogenetic analysis revealed intermingling of 2006–2007 and 2018 isolates rather than time-specific clustering, with low inter-group p-distances. Importantly, between the two temporal groups, no significant differences were detected in their respective identities to the vaccine strain S79 at the whole-genome level (nucleotide or amino acid). Two positively selected sites were identified across the seven structural proteins (posterior probability > 0.95). Eight mutations in HN and F that alter hydrophilicity, hydrophobicity, or charge were found, but structural modeling predicted no appreciable conformational changes. Conclusion We provides a whole-genome-based, two-time point comparison of genotype F mumps viruses in Shandong across a ~ 12-year interval spanning vaccine introduction (2006–2007 vs. Overall, the Shandong 2018 isolates remained as similar to the 2006–2007 isolates as F strains are nationwide, and both groups were comparably close to vaccine strain S79, indicating no detectable genetic divergence or drift over the ~12-year period. As the SH gene alone lacked sufficient diversity to resolve closely related isolates, whole-genome sequencing provided more accurate genetic characterization in this study.

title: Vaccination in Children with Paediatric Autoimmune and Autoinflammatory Rheumatic Diseases: Evidence on Safety, Immunogenicity and Effectiveness Across Live-Attenuated, mRNA and Recombinant Vaccines
abstract: Vaccination in children with paediatric autoimmune and autoinflammatory rheumatic diseases (pedAIIRDs) is clinically important but challenging. These children have an increased risk of infections due to both their underlying immune-mediated disease and the immunosuppressive therapies required for disease control. At the same time, immunosuppression may reduce vaccine-induced immune responses, while concerns about disease flares and the safety of live-attenuated vaccines may result in delayed or incomplete vaccination. This thesis aimed to generate clinically applicable, real-world evidence on the safety, immunogenicity and effectiveness of vaccination in children with pedAIIRDs receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Five studies addressed three vaccine platforms: the live-attenuated measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) booster vaccine, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV; Shingrix). In a cohort of 186 children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), MMR booster vaccination was not associated with increased disease activity, including in children receiving biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, and no serious vaccine-related adverse events were observed. Long-term evaluation of 182 children with JIA showed that most patients maintained protective antibodies against measles, mumps and rubella. However, measles seroprotection five years after vaccination was significantly lower in patients receiving biologic therapy at vaccination than in those not receiving biologics, supporting a targeted approach to serological monitoring. A systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a marked reduction in the risk of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). In a prospective cohort of 157 children with paediatric rheumatic diseases, COVID-19 mRNA vaccination induced humoral responses in nearly all patients and adequate T-cell responses in most tested patients. Although antibody concentrations were lower in patients receiving biologic therapy, vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic COVID-19 was preserved. No increase in disease activity, myocarditis or serious adverse events was identified. Finally, off-label use of RZV was evaluated in ten varicella-zoster-virus-naïve immunocompromised children for whom live-attenuated varicella vaccination was unsuitable. Nine of ten patients seroconverted following two doses. Two subsequently developed mild breakthrough varicella after household exposure and recovered without hospitalisation or antiviral treatment. Together, these studies support a shift from broad vaccine avoidance towards individualised, treatment-specific vaccination strategies in immunocompromised children. The findings provide evidence for the safe use of selected live vaccines, targeted monitoring of long-term vaccine-induced immunity, effective use of mRNA vaccines and further evaluation of non-live vaccine alternatives. These results may contribute to future national and international vaccination recommendations for children with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.

title_zh: 疫苗接种 治疗儿童自身免疫性和自身炎症性风湿病:减毒活疫苗、mRNA 和重组 疫苗 的安全性、免疫原性和有效性证据
source_body_en: Vaccination in children with paediatric autoimmune and autoinflammatory rheumatic diseases (pedAIIRDs) is clinically important but challenging. These children have an increased risk of infections due to both their underlying immune-mediated disease and the immunosuppressive therapies required for disease control. At the same time, immunosuppression may reduce vaccine-induced immune responses, while concerns about disease flares and the safety of live-attenuated vaccines may result in delayed or incomplete vaccination. This thesis aimed to generate clinically applicable, real-world evidence on the safety, immunogenicity and effectiveness of vaccination in children with pedAIIRDs receiving immunosuppressive therapy. Five studies addressed three vaccine platforms: the live-attenuated measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) booster vaccine, COVID-19 mRNA vaccines and the recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV; Shingrix). In a cohort of 186 children with juvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA), MMR booster vaccination was not associated with increased disease activity, including in children receiving biological disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs, and no serious vaccine-related adverse events were observed. Long-term evaluation of 182 children with JIA showed that most patients maintained protective antibodies against measles, mumps and rubella. However, measles seroprotection five years after vaccination was significantly lower in patients receiving biologic therapy at vaccination than in those not receiving biologics, supporting a targeted approach to serological monitoring. A systematic review and meta-analysis demonstrated that COVID-19 vaccination was associated with a marked reduction in the risk of multisystem inflammatory syndrome in children (MIS-C). In a prospective cohort of 157 children with paediatric rheumatic diseases, COVID-19 mRNA vaccination induced humoral responses in nearly all patients and adequate T-cell responses in most tested patients. Although antibody concentrations were lower in patients receiving biologic therapy, vaccine effectiveness against symptomatic COVID-19 was preserved. No increase in disease activity, myocarditis or serious adverse events was identified. Finally, off-label use of RZV was evaluated in ten varicella-zoster-virus-naïve immunocompromised children for whom live-attenuated varicella vaccination was unsuitable. Nine of ten patients seroconverted following two doses. Two subsequently developed mild breakthrough varicella after household exposure and recovered without hospitalisation or antiviral treatment. Together, these studies support a shift from broad vaccine avoidance towards individualised, treatment-specific vaccination strategies in immunocompromised children. The findings provide evidence for the safe use of selected live vaccines, targeted monitoring of long-term vaccine-induced immunity, effective use of mRNA vaccines and further evaluation of non-live vaccine alternatives. These results may contribute to future national and international vaccination recommendations for children with immune-mediated inflammatory diseases.
abstract_zh: 在患有儿科自身免疫和自身炎症性风湿性疾病(pedAIIRDs)的儿童中,疫苗接种具有临床重要性但具有挑战性。这些儿童由于其基础的免疫介导性疾病和用于疾病控制的免疫抑制治疗,感染风险增加。同时,免疫抑制可能会降低疫苗诱导的免疫应答,而对疾病复发和活疫苗疫苗安全性的担忧可能导致延迟或不完全的疫苗接种。本论文旨在为接受免疫抑制治疗的pedAIIRDs儿童生成具有临床应用价值的现实世界证据,以评估疫苗接种的安全性、免疫原性和有效性。五项研究涵盖了三种疫苗平台:活疫苗麻疹-麻疹-腮腺炎(MMR)加强针疫苗、新冠-19 mRNA疫苗和重组带状疱疹疫苗(RZV;Shingrix)。在一项针对186名幼年特发性关节炎(JIA)儿童的队列研究中,MMR加强针疫苗与疾病活动性增加无显著关联,包括在使用生物制剂疾病修饰抗风湿药物的儿童中,且未观察到严重的疫苗相关不良事件。对182名JIA儿童的长期评估显示,大多数患者在接种疫苗接种后仍保持对麻疹、麻疹和腮腺炎的保护性抗体。然而,接受生物治疗的患者在接种疫苗接种后五年内对麻疹的血清保护率显著低于未接受生物治疗的患者,支持对血清学监测采取针对性策略。一项系统综述和荟萃分析表明,新冠-19疫苗与儿童多系统炎症综合征(MIS-C)风险显著降低相关。在一项前瞻性队列研究中,针对157名儿科风湿病儿童,新冠-19 mRNA疫苗在几乎所有患者中诱导了体液免疫应答,并在大多数检测患者中诱导了足够的T细胞应答。尽管接受生物治疗的患者抗体浓度较低,但疫苗对出现症状的新冠-19感染的保护效果得以保持。未发现疾病活动性增加、心肌炎或严重不良事件。最后,对十名未感染水痘-带状疱疹病毒(varicella-zoster-virus)的免疫功能低下儿童进行了RZV的非标签使用评估,这些儿童因不适合接种活疫苗水痘疫苗而被纳入研究。在接种两剂后,有九名患者出现了血清学转换。其中两名患者在家庭接触后出现了轻度突破性水痘,但未需要住院治疗或抗病毒药物 治疗。综上所述,这些研究支持从广泛避免疫苗接种向免疫功能低下儿童个体化、针对性疫苗接种策略的转变。研究结果为选择性使用活疫苗、长期针对性监测疫苗诱导的免疫应答、有效使用mRNA疫苗以及进一步评估非活疫苗替代方案提供了证据。这些结果可能有助于未来国家和国际层面针对免疫介导炎症疾病的儿童制定疫苗接种建议。

title: The empty shell syndrome in Somalia’s aid‐driven health system and the pediatric malnutrition crisis
abstract: Abstract In early 2026, Somalia reached a critical threshold in pediatric malnutrition, with admissions hitting five-year highs. This surge is exacerbated by the simultaneous closure of nearly 500 nutrition clinics due to international funding cuts and a sharp, conflict-driven rise in fuel costs, which has fundamentally severed healthcare access for rural and displaced populations. This perspective examines the “empty shell” syndrome of Somalia’s aid-driven health system, which stems from reliance on off-budget, vertical programming. We analyze the combined mortality rates resulting from the interaction of severe acute malnutrition (SAM) with preventable infectious diseases such as measles and cholera. Addressing the largely overlooked child survival emergency requires a strategic shift from emergency handouts to comprehensive health system integration. We propose urgent interventions, including transport subsidies and the decentralization of stabilization centers, as immediate measures to save lives.

analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the aid-driven health system in Somalia, characterized by vertical programming and reliance on off-budget funding, has led to the closure of nearly 500 nutrition clinics, worsening access to care for rural and displaced populations. analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review highlights the lack of comprehensive integration of health systems and the absence of strategies to address the root causes of the malnutrition crisis. analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review suggests that urgent interventions, such as transport subsidies and the decentralization of stabilization centers, are needed to improve access to care. It also emphasizes the importance of shifting from emergency handouts to a more integrated health system approach to address the child survival emergency.

It argues that the current system, reliant on vertical programming and off-budget funding, has created an 'empty shell' syndrome, exacerbating the malnutrition emergency. elements_zh.scope_and_question: 本综述聚焦于索马里援助驱动的卫生体系对儿童营养不良危机的影响,特别是严重急性营养不良(SAM)激增及其与可预防传染病如麻疹的相互作用。核心问题是:卫生体系的结构性弱点如何加剧与营养不良相关的死亡率。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 本综述基于论文的摘要层面证据,讨论了索马里卫生体系的历史和现状背景、国际资金削减的作用以及燃料价格上涨对医疗服务可及性的影响。方法涉及对卫生体系结构及其对儿童生存影响的叙述性分析。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 综述得出结论:索马里援助驱动的卫生体系,其特点是垂直化项目和依赖非预算资金,已导致近500个营养诊所关闭,加剧了农村和流离失所人群获得医疗服务的困难。这造成了儿童营养不良的严重危机,入院人数达到五年来最高水平。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 综述指出,缺乏对卫生体系的全面整合,以及缺乏应对营养不良危机根本原因的策略。目前尚不清楚卫生体系的结构性弱点如何具体与麻疹及其他可预防疾病相互作用,从而增加死亡率。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 综述建议需要紧急干预,例如交通补贴和稳定中心的去中心化,以改善医疗服务的可及性。同时强调,应从紧急物资发放转向更加整合的卫生体系方法,以应对儿童生存危机。}}.{

abstract_zh: 摘要 2026 年初,索马里儿童营养不良达到了临界点,入院人数创五年来新高。由于国际资金削减和冲突导致的燃料成本急剧上升,近 500 家营养诊所同时关闭,这从根本上切断了农村和流离失所人口的医疗保健服务,加剧了这种激增。这一视角审视了索马里援助驱动的卫生系统的“空壳”综合症,该综合症源于对预算外垂直规划的依赖。我们分析了严重急性营养不良 (SAM) 与 麻疹 和霍乱等可预防传染病相互作用产生的综合 死亡率 率。解决在很大程度上被忽视的儿童生存紧急情况需要进行战略转变,从紧急救助转向全面的卫生系统整合。我们建议采取紧急干预措施,包括交通补贴和下放稳定中心,作为拯救生命的立即措施。
